summary.en: Search, validate, extract and replace text using explicit regular-expression boundaries and groups.
summary.bn: রেগুলার এক্সপ্রেশন দিয়ে টেক্সট খোঁজো, পুরো লেখা মেলাও, গ্রুপ থেকে মান নাও আর দরকারি অংশ বদলাও।

notes: All demonstrated patterns work on Python 3.10–3.12. Atomic groups and possessive quantifiers introduced in 3.11 are not used.

sections.title: Describe the shape of text instead of one exact word
Build patterns from literal and special characters
Search, capture and replace with a stated policy
Capture only what the caller needs
Check the match and the language layer
Stay within the shared regex feature set

examples.title: Compare search, match and fullmatch
examples.explanationHtml: search finds the code inside the sentence. match fails at the initial T, while fullmatch accepts only the complete standalone code.

examples.title: Extract named department and number groups
examples.explanationHtml: The named groups separate CSE and 212. The span covers positions zero through six, with six excluded as in a slice.

examples.title: Observe findall result shapes
examples.explanationHtml: No captures return full matches. One capture returns digit strings, while two captures return letter-and-number tuples.

examples.title: Reorder captured fields during substitution
examples.explanationHtml: The replacement function uses each match to build number-department text. The original immutable string remains unchanged.

examples.title: Match literal punctuation with re.escape
examples.explanationHtml: Escaping keeps the dot and plus literal in the first search. The separate numeric pattern extracts two ASCII digit runs.

practice.title: Validate a course code
practice.statementHtml: Read one line. Print VALID only when the entire line is exactly three ASCII uppercase letters followed by three ASCII digits; otherwise print INVALID.

practice.title: Sum digit runs
practice.statementHtml: Read one line of ASCII text, possibly empty. Find all maximal runs of digits 0 through 9 and print the sum of their integer values. There are no signed-number rules; a minus sign is ordinary separating text.
hints: findall without captures returns each full run.

practice.title: Replace whitespace runs
practice.statementHtml: Read one line of text. Replace every nonempty run of spaces or tabs with one underscore and print the new text. Preserve any resulting leading or trailing underscore.
hints: Use a class limited to the requested space and tab characters.

practice.title: Extract bounded mark records
practice.statementHtml: Read one line containing arbitrary ASCII text. Extract tokens shaped as R followed by one or more ASCII digits, a colon, and one to three ASCII mark digits. The whole token must be bounded by a whitespace character or a string end on both sides. Keep only marks from 0 to 100. Print roll mark pairs in encounter order, or NONE if no valid token remains.
hints: The lookarounds require whitespace boundaries; apply numeric range validation after extraction.

quiz.explanation: One capture returns that captured text per match.

quiz.explanation: Check for None before reading groups.

quiz.prompt: Why use raw string literals for regex patterns?
options: To avoid an extra layer of Python backslash escapes
quiz.explanation: The regex engine still interprets its own syntax.

quiz.prompt: Which pattern explicitly matches one ASCII digit?
quiz.explanation: A numeric range states the ASCII policy directly.

quiz.prompt: What does a noncapturing group avoid?
options: Changing capture numbering and findall shape
The need for a source string
quiz.explanation: Use (?:...) for structural grouping without extraction.

quiz.prompt: Which tool makes arbitrary text literal in a regex pattern?
quiz.explanation: It escapes pattern metacharacters, not general replacement templates.

keyPoints.en: search finds a match anywhere while match starts at the beginning.
keyPoints.bn: search টেক্সটের যেকোনো জায়গায় খোঁজে, match শুরু থেকে মেলায়।
fullmatch পুরো স্ট্রিং প্যাটার্নের সঙ্গে মেলে কি না দেখে।

keyPoints.en: Raw string literals avoid an extra Python backslash interpretation.
keyPoints.bn: র স্ট্রিং লিখলে ব্যাকস্ল্যাশ পাইথনের স্ট্রিংয়ের নিয়মে বদলে যায় না।

keyPoints.en: Groups capture meaningful parts of a match.
keyPoints.bn: গ্রুপ দিয়ে মিলে যাওয়া লেখার দরকারি অংশ আলাদা করে নেওয়া যায়।

keyPoints.en: findall results depend on the number of capturing groups.
keyPoints.bn: কয়টি ক্যাপচারিং গ্রুপ আছে তার ওপর findall-এর ফলের ধরন বদলায়।

keyPoints.en: Use ordinary string methods for simple fixed-text tasks.
keyPoints.bn: নির্দিষ্ট লেখা খোঁজা বা বদলানোর সহজ কাজে স্ট্রিং মেথড ব্যবহার করো।

examQuestions.question: Compare search, match and fullmatch on a course code.
examQuestions.answerHtml: search finds a matching code anywhere in text. match starts at the beginning but may accept a prefix. fullmatch requires the complete string to fit the pattern, making it suitable for one whole code.

examQuestions.question: Explain how capturing groups affect findall results.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Without captures, findall returns full-match strings. One capture returns the captured strings. Several captures return tuples. Use noncapturing groups for structure when extraction is not wanted.

examQuestions.question: Design validation for text containing a course code and a mark.
examQuestions.answerHtml: First define explicit text boundaries and ASCII digit rules. Extract department, number and mark with named or numbered groups. Then convert and check the mark range and look up the course in the offered-course data. Pattern shape alone cannot prove those domain rules.
